# splunkctl users

Manage users and roles.

## users create

Create a new user.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl users create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | - | Username. [required] |
| `--password` | text | - | Password. [required] |
| `--roles` | text | - | Comma-separated role names. [required] |
| `--email` | text | - | Email address. |
| `--realname` | text | - | Display name. |

## users delete

Delete a user.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl users delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## users get

Get details for a single user.

```text
splunkctl users get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## users list

List all users.

```text
splunkctl users list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |
